title: Assist state diagram
description: Assist.status, the agent that composes a default commit message while the editor is open. The Editor drives it: Editor::new starts it for an empty message, Ctrl+N and Ctrl+E cycle the agent and effort, a change of file marks plans a restart 1.5 s later (RESTART_MS), and Editor::tick, called by Term::run every 100 ms while it is busy, takes in the composer's answer. Starting a run cancels the one still going, and the composer kills the agent's process group when the editor closes. Only commit messages get an Assist (message::assistant).

states.description: message::assistant has found the agents on PATH (claude, codex, gemini, in that order) and read the saved zazzle.agent and zazzle.effort from the global git config.
Status::NoAgent: no agent CLI on PATH; the agent line says `No agent CLI found (claude, codex or gemini): write the message yourself`.
Status::Idle: an agent is chosen but no run has started, because the message was not empty.
Status::Composing { since }: the agent runs in the background; the agent line shows `<agent> is composing default commit message` and a dot per 500 ms (DOT_MS).
Status::Ready: the answer, without a code fence, is the suggestion, shown dimmed in an empty message and used by Ctrl+S.
Status::Failed: the agent exited non-zero (its first error line), answered nothing, could not be started, or was killed after 300 s (AGENT_TIMEOUT); the agent line says `<agent> failed: <reason>`.

transitions.guard: At least one agent was found
transitions.action: Chooses the saved agent if found, else the first; its saved effort if it has that level, else its default.
Called by Editor::new for an empty message, by Ctrl+S on an empty message, by Ctrl+N or Ctrl+E, or by a tick when a planned restart is due; builds the prompt and starts the agent's command line.

transitions.guard: The agent exited 0 with a non-empty answer
The agent failed, gave an empty answer, could not be started or timed out

transitions.trigger: Ctrl+N, Ctrl+E, or a tick 1.5 s after the last file mark change
transitions.guard: Ctrl+N: more than one agent found; Ctrl+E: the agent has effort levels
transitions.action: The running agent is killed and a new run starts; Ctrl+N and Ctrl+E save the choice in zazzle.agent and zazzle.effort.

transitions.trigger: Ctrl+N, Ctrl+E, or a tick 1.5 s after the last file mark change
transitions.guard: Ctrl+N: more than one agent found; Ctrl+E: the agent has effort levels
transitions.action: A new run starts; the choice is saved as above.

transitions.trigger: Ctrl+N, Ctrl+E, or a tick 1.5 s after the last file mark change
transitions.guard: Ctrl+N: more than one agent found; Ctrl+E: the agent has effort levels
transitions.action: A new run starts; the choice is saved as above.

transitions.guard: Only one agent was found (Ctrl+N), or it has no effort levels (Ctrl+E)
transitions.action: Shows `<agent> is the only agent CLI found` or `<agent> has no effort setting`.

transitions.trigger: Ctrl+N, Ctrl+E or a file mark change
transitions.action: Ctrl+N and Ctrl+E show `No agent CLI found (claude, codex or gemini)`; nothing starts.
